name: Shirley Rudolph
office: Lawndale School District, Governing Board Member, Trustee Area No. 2

items.text: Shirley Rudolph is a member of the Lawndale Elementary School District governing board, representing Trustee Area 2. She was elected to the board in 1993. She served as board president, with a term expiring in 2013. She serves as board clerk. By 1988, she had served on the Lawndale Parks, Recreation and Social Services Commission for five years.
